newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI steps in to prop dollar at 35.70 rupees.
newsitem.headline: India RBI steps in to prop dollar at 35.70 rupees.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) stepped in on Tuesday to prop up the dollar at 35.70 rupees, after it breached the 35.70-mark, to trade at 35.69, dealers said.
"In the morning, several banks went to him (RBI, to sell dollars), but he didn't buy," said a foreign bank dealer.
"In the afternoon, he himself came to buy at 35.70 and now banks are offering to him at this rate," he said.
There were stray deals at 35.7025, but most of the day's deals were at 35.6975/7000, dealers said.
